doc: Fish Monster Swamp (s05), floor 6 of Rainbow Butterfly Wood (dungeon stage 1). The party meets the fisherman Noam, who gives them a Fishing Rod for Grape Juice, finds the villagers bewitched and meets the swamp master Mardan, who sends them to catch a Priscleen Fish before he turns the three back. Story events 215 to 253 drive this, with events 230, 235 and 247 and Utan moving the boulder in the s05b script.
